parsed.brief_reason: The patch correctly addresses an integer overflow bug in the safeMultiply method by detecting when negating Long.MIN_VALUE would overflow and throwing an ArithmeticException. This is a general fix that applies to the root cause. However, the code formatting is poor with the if statement on the same line as the return, significantly reducing readability.
